english.title: Driver of a motor vehicle permit it to remain stationary in residents only bay - local traffic order w/i Greater London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD AND LOCATION..), permitted the motor vehicle to remain stationary in a parking bay which had been designated for use by residents by **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL TRAFFIC ORDER..), only when you were not the holder of a valid residents parking permit for that bay
english.legislation: Contrary to the above Local Traffic Order and sections 6 and 8 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) and permitted the motor vehicle to remain stationary in a parking bay which had been designated for use by residents only. The defendant was not the holder of a valid residents parking permit for that bay.
